notes.title: Lost in Cheese Demo – Patch Notes 0.0.11
notes.content:
This update brings a number of improvements focused on polish and player experience. We’ve made some initial adjustments to audio levels, introduced display settings for more flexibility, and fixed a few UI issues based on player feedback.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Lowered first launch volume settings from 100% to 75%[/h3]
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h3]Added build info to main menu[/h3]
[*] [h3]Fixed issue where main menu was hidden after save settings prompt[/h3]
[*] [h3]Added Display settings options[/h3]
Display mode: Windowed / Windowed Fullscreen / Fullscreen
Screen Resolution options
FPS limit
V-Sync toggle
[/list]

Huge thanks to everyone who has sent in bug reports and suggestions—your input is helping shape the game!

notes.title: Demo out now
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zp37xJM-wGU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]Snovittra is thrilled to announce the release of a free playable demo for their upcoming cozy puzzle adventure, Lost in Cheese. Available now on Steam, the demo offers players a first taste of the charming, brain-teasing journey ahead. The full game is set to release later this year.

The demo introduces players to the game’s unique movement mechanics, cozy visuals, and satisfying puzzle flow. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or lose yourself in a cute, cheese-filled mystery, Lost in Cheese delivers a refreshingly mellow gameplay experience.

The demo is available now on Steam. Get ready to roll, relax, and discover what’s really behind all the cheese.

notes.title: Release in Q3 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43771388/ec666555938fa51296f7333c77415fa276cddd24.png[/img]

We are happy to announce that Lost in Cheese will be released in Q3 2025.
Lost in Cheese is really shaping up and will bring you a relaxing game, a quirky story and lots of fun puzzles to solve. 

And yes, we did change the name to our game, if are an early follower, we used to be called something else, but had to change the name and we also felt a need to fill our game with cheese. But there is no need to worry, the game is now even better as we are working hard to make a really great game.

Stay tuned for more info!
